common_evaluation.scoring: L0-only measured observation-row chunks; concatenate whole case; one upper callback; no query GT in forward

runtime.physical_batch_selection: actual full-shape CUDA cloned calibration with three trials on explicit supplied candidates; record samples/candidates/views
runtime.D_default32_failure: stop with measured resource diagnosis; do not insert a lower candidate
runtime.code_commit_binding: Server shell resolves the actual checkout HEAD and requires equality when CP_CODE_COMMIT is explicitly supplied; final command pins the reviewed exact commit; source-byte identity remains required

timing.epoch_wall: continuous monotonic active wall; stopped-process downtime excluded; asynchronous phase durations may overlap and are never summed into epoch wall
timing.C: own-task training, support refresh, own/common evaluation and epoch-end checkpoint publication; bound checkpoint timing receipt restores its write tail
timing.D: loader/setup, optimizer updates, full support refresh, whole-candidate validation and next-epoch cursor checkpoint publication; bound asynchronous write journal restores its saved write tail
timing.missing_resume_write_receipt: retain saved pre-write elapsed as an explicit lower bound
timing.outside_epoch: initial preparation/calibration/initial validation, stopped-process downtime and final selected-checkpoint benchmark

implementation.ready_scope: implemented server entry and local actual-CT/CUDA DEBUG mechanics; server resource preflight and production training still required
